Between the lions : get wild about reading

A series that teaches children to read with humorous characters, stories, skits, parodies, and songs. Should Lionel and Leona open a mysterious box that has a "Do Not Open" sing on it? Lionel ties himself up with ropes and tries to escape without magic words. Everyone read jokes to Click the Mouse to try to make her laugh. Lionel and Leona persuade Click to take a magic popcorn popper out of a book and then can't make it stop popping! When Lionel reads the latest "Cliff Hanger" book to Leona, it gives her an idea about how to make one of her biggest dreams come true. Leona helps a sculptor who falls in love with the statue
